summary: ULTRA-LONG URBAN LONGEVITY FACTORS ENGINEERING F161–F170 · STARLI · White Rainbow Era · Research Working Edition v1.3 Prospective scientific technical notebook. Prospective offline engineering research using synthetic factor ledgers. Preserve independent minimum endpoints, calibrated risk, rights and consent. Longevity factors are proxies, not survival years, biological lifespan or safety certification. 超長城市長壽因子工程 一座真正偉大的城市,不在於它建造了多少高塔, 而在於多少生命能夠在其中安然生活。 讓建築擁有修復的能力,讓能源擁有延續的能力, 讓科技擁有服務生命的方向,讓文明擁有重新開始的勇氣。 我們不追求一座永遠不會受傷的城市, 而是探索一座即使經歷風雨,依然能夠重新開花的城市。 讓美好具有繼續發生的能力。 A city becomes enduring not because nothing within it ever dies, but because renewal, dignity, memory, and the possibility of a better tomorrow can continue across generations. Ten flagship studies F161 | Unified Definition and Measurement of Urban Longevity Factors Primary endpoint: candidate longevity index [1]. Minimum prototype: an eight-factor synthetic risk ledger. Strong comparator: independent dashboards and equal-weight arithmetic means. Independent stop: unresolved subjective weights and double counting, failed service constraint, or invalid evidence boundary. Secondary endpoint: weakest factor value [1]. F162 | Structural Urban Longevity Factors and Material Durability Primary endpoint: remaining function ratio [%]. Minimum prototype: published aging data schemas and synthetic replacement scenarios. Strong comparator: conventional durability design and maintenance models. Independent stop: unresolved short-term test extrapolation, failed service constraint, or invalid evidence boundary. Secondary endpoint: replacement cost [CU]. F163 | Urban Energy Longevity Factors and Supply Stability Primary endpoint: long-term unserved energy [MWh/year]. Minimum prototype: multi-year synthetic energy time series. Strong comparator: mature reliability planning. Independent stop: unresolved annual averages hiding peaks, failed service constraint, or invalid evidence boundary. Secondary endpoint: local delivered energy fraction [%]. F164 | Urban Regenerative Longevity Factors and Repair Efficiency Primary endpoint: post-repair damage fraction [1]. Minimum prototype: synthetic urban damage time series. Strong comparator: periodic maintenance models. Independent stop: unresolved indicator closure without functional restoration, failed service constraint, or invalid evidence boundary. Secondary endpoint: maintenance cost [CU/year]. F165 | Urban Information Longevity Factors and Memory Integrity Primary endpoint: long-term verified reconstruction rate [%]. Minimum prototype: multi-generation synthetic data migration. Strong comparator: offsite backup and open formats. Independent stop: unresolved testing only on the original platform, failed service constraint, or invalid evidence boundary. Secondary endpoint: data recovery time [h]. F166 | Urban Ecological Longevity Factors and Environmental Carrying Capacity Primary endpoint: maximum carrying load ratio [1]. Minimum prototype: synthetic water and land resource scenarios. Strong comparator: conventional resource budgets and ecological indicators. Independent stop: unresolved ignored cross-boundary environmental cost, failed service constraint, or invalid evidence boundary. Secondary endpoint: ecological exceedance duration [day]. F167 | Urban Economic Longevity Factors and Financial Resilience Primary endpoint: liquid reserve runway [month]. Minimum prototype: multi-period synthetic city budgets. Strong comparator: conventional reserve funds and stress testing. Independent stop: unresolved book value treated as liquid cash, failed service constraint, or invalid evidence boundary. Secondary endpoint: public service shortfall [%]. F168 | Urban Institutional Longevity Factors and Governance Adaptability Primary endpoint: qualified institutional revision time [day]. Minimum prototype: virtual institutional revisions and civic deliberation. Strong comparator: mature human deliberation and judicial review. I

direction_title: Memory Cortex: new source-grounded retrieval and continual-memory research [REVERSE]
summary: The source of the paper "Gravitational Camera: A Thought Experiment", the Python reference implementation that produces and tests every number in it ( reference/gravcam ; the paper's Appendix B lists the module and the test for each result), the code that draws its figures, and the interactive site. The site also carries a tutorial and a book; their text is not part of this archive, so the site's tutorial pages do not build from it, while the paper, its figures and the reference implementation do. The code is under the MIT licence; the paper's text and figures are under CC BY 4.0.
title: Gravitational Camera: A Thought Experiment (paper, reference implementation and site)
